## GPT-4o API

GPT-4o is a large language model by OpenAI, available on the Venice API as `openai-gpt-4o-2024-11-20`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

OpenAI's multimodal model with vision capabilities, strong reasoning, and broad knowledge. Popular for its balanced performance across tasks. Version: 2024-11-20.

### GPT-4o API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `openai-gpt-4o-2024-11-20` | Standard | Anonymized | $2.50 / $10.00 per 1M |

### GPT-4o specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | OpenAI |
| Released | Feb 28, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Context window | 128K tokens |
| Max output | 16K tokens |

### How to use the GPT-4o API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "openai-gpt-4o-2024-11-20"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "openai-gpt-4o-2024-11-20",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
